installer.video_nodes_desc: Video nodes (MiniMax H3, LTX): KJNodes, VideoHelperSuite, GGUF (light models for low VRAM), SelfLift (progressive H3 rendering) and the H3 latent upscaler (used by Escalar y refinar).
installer.interfaz_nodes_desc: Interface extras, with no Python dependencies: rgthree-comfy (the green progress bar at the top of the screen and widely used nodes such as Fast Groups Bypasser) and ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts (the Show Image Feed button with your generated images, and autocomplete).
installer.comunidad_nodes_desc: Nodes that many shared workflows use: ComfyUI Essentials, Comfyroll, WAS Node Suite and ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors (depth, pose and edge maps). They bring heavy dependencies: installation takes several more minutes and downloads a lot. If you skip them now, ComfyUI offers them through the Manager when you open a workflow that needs them.

installer.nunchaku_needs:
Nunchaku publishes builds up to PyTorch {need}; you have {have}.
   Using it requires switching PyTorch to {need} (same CUDA, ~3 GB download).
   It only helps image models (FLUX, Qwen-Image, Z-Image); video does not need it.
   The current state is saved first and, if anything stops loading, it rolls back on its own.

setup.error.PATH_LOCAL_ABSOLUTE_REQUIRED: The folder must be on a disk in this computer, for example D:\AI.
setup.error.PATH_UNSAFE_CHARACTERS: The path contains characters that break the launchers (% ! ? & | < > ^ "). Choose a folder with a simple name, for example D:\AI.
setup.error.PATH_NON_ASCII: The path contains accents or other special characters, which break some nodes and packages. Choose a folder with a simple name, for example D:\AI.
setup.error.PATH_DRIVE_ROOT: ComfyUI cannot be installed directly in the root of a disk. Choose or create a folder.
setup.error.PATH_ONEDRIVE: The folder is inside OneDrive: it would sync thousands of files and may leave them cloud-only. Choose a folder outside OneDrive, for example D:\AI.
setup.error.PATH_REPARSE: The folder is a link to another location ({detail}). Choose a regular folder.
setup.error.PATH_PROTECTED: That is a system folder ({detail}). Choose another one, for example D:\AI.
setup.error.PATH_OVERLAP: That folder is inside another ComfyUI installation, or contains one ({detail}). Choose a separate folder so they are not mixed.
setup.error.PATH_NOT_DIRECTORY: A file with that name already exists. Choose another folder.
setup.error.PATH_NOT_EMPTY: The folder {detail} already contains files. Choose an empty one: the installer never deletes or mixes existing files.
setup.error.PATH_FIXED_DISK_REQUIRED: Choose an internal disk. USB, network or removable drives are not suitable for ComfyUI.
setup.error.DISK_SPACE: Not enough space: at least {detail} GB must be free on that disk. Free up space or choose another disk.
setup.error.GPU_UNKNOWN: No NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics card was detected. ComfyUI needs one to work well.
setup.error.GPU_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN: Your NVIDIA card could not be read. Install or update the driver from https://www.nvidia.com/drivers, restart and run the installer again.
setup.error.GPU_ARCHITECTURE_UNSUPPORTED: Your NVIDIA card does not work with that CUDA version. Run the installer without --cuda so it picks the right one.
setup.error.DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Your NVIDIA driver is too old for this card (minimum {detail}). Update it from https://www.nvidia.com/drivers, restart and run the installer again.
setup.error.CUDA_NVIDIA_ONLY: The --cuda option only applies to NVIDIA cards.
setup.error.GPU_UNSUPPORTED: There is no official ComfyUI package for this graphics card yet.
setup.error.DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST_INVALID: The installer's download list is damaged. Download the installer again.
setup.error.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download was interrupted. Run the installer again: it resumes where it stopped.
setup.error.DOWNLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH: The downloaded file does not match the tested version, so it is not used. Run the installer again to download it again.
setup.error.EXTRACTION_FAILED: ComfyUI could not be extracted. The files were kept in {detail} for review; run the installer again.
setup.error.PORTABLE_LAYOUT_INVALID: The ComfyUI package does not have the expected layout. Run the installer again.
setup.error.DESTINATION_CHANGED_DURING_D: Files appeared in the destination folder during the download. They were not touched; run the installer again.
setup.error.ARGUMENT_MISSING: An option is missing its value. Use --help to see how options work.
setup.error.ARGUMENT_UNKNOWN: Unknown option: {detail}. Use --help to see the options.
setup.error.WINDOWS_X64_REQUIRED: This installer requires 64-bit Windows on an Intel or AMD processor.
setup.error.CURL_REQUIRED: curl.exe, included with Windows 10 and 11, is missing. Update Windows and run the installer again.
setup.error.INSTALLATION_NOT_FOUND: That folder has no ComfyUI installation. Choose the folder that contains ComfyUI\main.py.
setup.error.MAINTENANCE_PORTABLE_ONLY: Only a portable ComfyUI (with python_embeded) can be reconfigured. This installation is kept unchanged.
setup.error.OUTPUT_PATH_UNSAFE: The output folder contains characters that break the launchers (% ! & | < > ^ "). Choose another one.
setup.error.PYTHON_MATRIX_MISMATCH: The downloaded ComfyUI does not ship the expected Python version ({detail}). Run the installer again in a new folder.
setup.error.CUDA_MATRIX_MISMATCH: The downloaded ComfyUI does not ship the expected CUDA version ({detail}). Run the installer again in a new folder.
setup.error.TORCH_MATRIX_MISMATCH: The downloaded ComfyUI does not ship the expected PyTorch version ({detail}). Run the installer again in a new folder.
setup.error.GPU_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE: PyTorch cannot use your graphics card. This is almost always an old driver: update it, restart and run the installer again.
setup.error.GIT_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Portable Git could not be downloaded. Check your connection and run the installer again.
setup.error.GIT_HASH_MISMATCH: The downloaded Git does not match the tested version, so it is not used. Run the installer again.
setup.error.GIT_ARCHIVE_UNSAFE: The downloaded Git package is damaged. Run the installer again.
setup.error.GIT_ARCHIVE_INVALID: The downloaded Git package is damaged. Run the installer again.
setup.error.GIT_START_FAILED: Portable Git does not start on this computer. Install Git for Windows and run the installer again.
setup.error.NODE_REVISION_INVALID: The installer's node list is damaged ({detail}). Download the installer again.
setup.error.NODE_SOURCE_INVALID: The installer's node list is damaged ({detail}). Download the installer again.
setup.error.NODE_PATH_INVALID: The installer's node list is damaged ({detail}). Download the installer again.
